title: Ansel and the Inheritance
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Rafael Okonkwo, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
